release_description:
IRO / MATHEMATICAL RELEASE RECORD
========================================
Release title / kana: るもらをぬてふ
Release name / cipher code: 24-73-41-25-23-57-54
Seed: 211
Canvas: 3000 × 3000 px
Palette: paper=#F2EFE5; black=#101010; graphite=#3A3A3A; burgundy=#8B1E1E
Cipher: Uesugi-style Iroha 7x7 checkerboard adaptation. Historical attribution is uncertain.
Coordinates are row-column, one-based; 48 Iroha syllables occupy 48 of 49 cells.
Iroha checkerboard, row-major order:
  i | ro | ha | ni | ho | he | to
  chi | ri | nu | ru | wo | wa | ka
  yo | ta | re | so | tsu | ne | na
  ra | mu | u | wi | no | o | ku
  ya | ma | ke | fu | ko | e | te
  a | sa | ki | yu | me | mi | shi
  we | hi | mo | se | su | n | 
Generated syllables: ru mo ra wo nu te fu
Encoded title: 24-73-41-25-23-57-54

GLOBAL PARAMETERS
--------------------
frequency = 5.000000
amplitude = 1.000000
density = 1.000000
structure = 1.000000
grain = 0.150000
mass_x = 0.620000
mass_y = 0.480000
field_width = 0.360000
line_weight = 1.000000

COMPOSITION SOLUTION
----------------------
1. Render equation families using deterministic seeds and layer-specific parameter offsets.
2. Derive ink alpha from each pixel's difference against #F2EFE5; suppress tiny paper deviations.
3. Composite weighted black/graphite ink masks over a constant paper canvas.
4. Extract burgundy pixels from source layers and composite them as a signal accent.
5. Export editable RGBA layers, final cover, a 12-panel variation sheet, visual documentation and normalized music data.
No generative-AI image is used; every visual layer is generated by equations in run.py.

LAYER STACK / EQUATIONS
------------------------

[01] INTERFERENCE
seed = 8130
weight = 1.0
blend = pixel-difference ink mask, weighted alpha-over-paper; burgundy mask composited as signal accent
editable layer = output\releases\るもらをぬてふ_24-73-41-25-23-57-54\layers\01-interference.png
model = phi1=2*pi*f*x/L + 0.7*sin(2*pi*f*y/L); phi2=2*pi*(0.63*f*x/L-y/L); y'=y+A*0.048*L*E*(sin(phi1)+0.32*sin(phi2+phi1/3))
parameters = {"amplitude": 1.0, "density": 1.0, "field_width": 0.2736, "frequency": 3.5999999999999996, "grain": 0.15, "line_weight": 1.0, "mass_x": 0.526, "mass_y": 0.48, "structure": 1.0}
renderer equations:
  - φ₁ = 2π f x/L + 0.7 sin(2π f y/L); φ₂ = 2π(0.63f)x/L − 2πy/L
  - y′ = y + A·0.055L·E(x,y)[sin(φ₁) + 0.32 sin(φ₂ + φ₁/3)]
  - E = exp(−((x−mₓL)/(wL))² − 0.35((y−mᵧL)/(0.42L))²)
  - Only the envelope is densely sampled; paper outside it remains deliberately quiet

[02] ARC
seed = 16049
weight = 0.68
blend = pixel-difference ink mask, weighted alpha-over-paper; burgundy mask composited as signal accent
editable layer = output\releases\るもらをぬてふ_24-73-41-25-23-57-54\layers\02-arc.png
model = r=sqrt((x-mx)^2+(y-my)^2); C_k(theta)=(mx+R_k*cos(theta), my+0.82*R_k*sin(theta))
parameters = {"amplitude": 1.0, "density": 1.0, "field_width": 0.3132, "frequency": 4.3, "grain": 0.15, "line_weight": 1.0, "mass_x": 0.573, "mass_y": 0.5543748607839352, "structure": 1.0}
renderer equations:
  - r(x,y)=√((x−mₓL)²+(y−mᵧL)²)
  - Cₖ: r=R+kΔR; render an angular sector clipped by the canvas
  - Field width controls contour spacing; mass position controls the crop

[03] SPECTRAL
seed = 23968
weight = 0.52
blend = pixel-difference ink mask, weighted alpha-over-paper; burgundy mask composited as signal accent
editable layer = output\releases\るもらをぬてふ_24-73-41-25-23-57-54\layers\03-spectral.png
model = I(x)=exp(-((x/L-mass_x)/field_width)^2); P(sample)=I(x)^1.8*exp(-((y/L-mass_y)/0.34)^2)
parameters = {"amplitude": 1.0, "density": 1.0, "field_width": 0.3528, "frequency": 5.0, "grain": 0.15, "line_weight": 1.0, "mass_x": 0.62, "mass_y": 0.46083441734798763, "structure": 1.0}
renderer equations:
  - I(x)=exp(−((x−mₓL)/(wL))²)
  - At xᵢ, sample yⱼ with probability I(xᵢ) × exp(−((yⱼ−mᵧL)/(0.34L))²)
  - Signal density has a deliberate onset, peak and abrupt fade

[04] COORDINATE
seed = 31887
weight = 0.72
blend = pixel-difference ink mask, weighted alpha-over-paper; burgundy mask composited as signal accent
editable layer = output\releases\るもらをぬてふ_24-73-41-25-23-57-54\layers\04-coordinate.png
model = G(i,j)=(mx+i*dx,my+j*dy); cell acceptance probability is proportional to the anisotropic envelope E(x,y)
parameters = {"amplitude": 1.0, "density": 1.0, "field_width": 0.3924, "frequency": 5.700000000000001, "grain": 0.15, "line_weight": 1.0, "mass_x": 0.667, "mass_y": 0.41056389882542005, "structure": 1.0}
renderer equations:
  - G(i,j) = (mₓ + iΔₓ, mᵧ + jΔᵧ); Δ ∝ 1/(frequency × structure)
  - Keep cells inside an anisotropic field envelope; suppress marks outside it
  - A single weighted registration bar anchors the composition

[05] POINTS
seed = 39806
weight = 0.38
blend = pixel-difference ink mask, weighted alpha-over-paper; burgundy mask composited as signal accent
editable layer = output\releases\るもらをぬてふ_24-73-41-25-23-57-54\layers\05-points.png
model = rho(x,y)=exp(-((x-mx)/(field_width*L))^2-0.35*((y-my)/(0.34*L))^2); sample points accepted by rho^(1+0.7*structure)
parameters = {"amplitude": 1.0, "density": 1.0, "field_width": 0.432, "frequency": 6.4, "grain": 0.15, "line_weight": 1.0, "mass_x": 0.714, "mass_y": 0.5170585013353955, "structure": 1.0}
renderer equations:
  - ρ(x,y) = exp(−½[(x−mₓL)/σₓ]² − ½[(y−mᵧL)/σᵧ]²)
  - Accept point with probability ρᵞ; γ rises with structure to sharpen the edge
  - Point density follows one weighted field rather than uniform random scatter

MUSIC DATA / SHARED MATHEMATICAL FEATURES
--------------------------------------------
Samples: 256
Files: music-data.json (named fields), music-data.csv (tabular), sonic_pi_data.rb (Sonic Pi-ready array).
Rows sample t=0..1. Mapping guidance is in music-data.json.
Track titles are generated as Iroha kana plus their row-column cipher code; see tracklist.json/CSV.
Seed, field centre, width, frequency and amplitude drive the cover and the derived audio features.
Rhythm exports: drum-programming.json (Euclidean pulse grid), breaks.json (ghost notes and swing),
polyrhythms.json (3:2, 4:3, 5:4, 7:4), and rhythm-events.csv (beat-based DAW interchange).
Synthesis exports: synthesis-data.json and synthesis-presets.json describe deterministic WAV recipes;
samples/ contains percussion, FM, hybrid-bass and effect-rich one-shots; tones/ contains an eight-note bank.
signal-analysis.json includes RMS, zero crossings and spectral summary; SciPy is optional.
visual-analysis.json records ink coverage, negative space, quadrant balance and mass centroid.
composition-preview.png visualizes the cover beside its 8x8 ink-density field.
Sonic Pi snippets are in sonic_pi/; raw CSV event tables are in raw/.
Math-native IDM entity library: 8 equation families × 6 variations, rendered as named WAV entities.
entity-library.json/CSV record source features, equations, seeds, duration and measured levels.
entity-events.json/CSV maps the same release features into named entity events for Sonic Pi.
sonic_pi/entities.rb registers named WAV entities; sonic_pi/arrangement.rb schedules the data-derived score.
